errors.text_span: след което регистрира лек спад до около 6.5% в месец 5
errors.evidence: This oversimplifies the trend between month 3 and month 5 of 2021. After the peak of ~7.1% in month 3, the line drops to ~6.4% in month 4 and then rises to ~6.5% in month 5. Describing this as a simple drop to 6.5% is inaccurate and misses the local minimum and subsequent rise.

errors.text_span: и нов спад до 2.1% в месец 12
errors.evidence: The value in month 12 of 2021 is approximately 2.9%, not 2.1%. The value 2.1% corresponds to the local minimum in month 8 of 2021.
